expected_behavior: For W3(df,diag(v)) versus W3(5,I), the explicit Wishart KL formula gives the reference for each item. Nonzero p.df and p covariance gradients are independently established analytically and with a central finite difference for df.
bug_signature: The complete batch vector matches subtracting the df term summed across the batch instead of per item. p.df and p covariance gradients are both None despite nonzero reference derivatives. Both manifestations are tested; the policy may split their root counts. float64 rtol/atol=1e-10 for KL; finite-difference h=1e-4 is diagnostic, not a wrong-value snapshot.
